facts.business: National Plastic Technologies Ltd manufactures plastic components, primarily for automotive OEMs, with over 90% of sales from top 5 customers including Hero Moto Corp added in FY26.
key_risks: Credit Risk: Risk of financial loss if customers fail to meet obligations, though major customers are well-reputed and dues received regularly.
Liquidity Risk: Risk of inability to meet financial obligations due to lack of liquid assets; financial liabilities largely towards term loan repayments and lease liabilities.
Interest Rate Risk: Exposure to interest rate risk from borrowings from banks and financial institutions; risk assessed as relatively low due to stable interest rate environment in India.
External Geo-political Risks: Risks from war, tariffs affecting macro conditions and cost pressures; company passes on cost pressures to customers.
Customer Concentration Risk: More than 90% of sales from top 5 customers; company added Hero Moto Corp in FY26 and is in discussions with other OEMs to diversify.
facts.related_party_note: No contracts or arrangements not at arm's length basis (NIL). Company in compliance with Section 177 and 188 of the Act for related party transactions; details disclosed in standalone financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
